## v2.10.1 - 2026-05-04

Cullit transitions to a fully open-source sponsorship model.

### Open-Source Transition

- Retired legacy checkout and billing purchase flows in favor of GitHub Sponsors.
- Removed plan-based feature gating across dashboard and runtime paths.
- Kept legacy billing/tier payload fields for compatibility.

### Documentation

- Updated architecture, database, legal, and support docs for OSS-first messaging.
- Added explicit migration notes for legacy billing endpoints and historical data.

### Contributors

@mttaylor

## v2.10.1 - 2026-05-04

This release finalizes Cullit's OSS sponsorship transition.

### Highlights

- Billing endpoints are compatibility-only and no longer run legacy checkout.
- Dashboard and tests now reflect open-access behavior for all users.
- Release notes and docs now consistently point to GitHub Sponsors support.

### Contributors
